summary: Full frontend QA of the SafeDeal redesign (short landing + unified home + tabs) on the preview host. Landing desktop/mobile, hero form validation, guest->signin->auto-create-deal, unified home (Overview/Deals/Activity/Documents) both routes /safedeal/deals and /safedeal/wallet, populated moxxcompany@gmail.com read-only scenario, mobile home, and regression paths all pass. Found 1 HIGH interaction bug on the landing hero form (a decorative overlay intercepts pointer events on the 'Share a link' toggle) and 1 minor mobile-tab truncation.

ui_bugs.issue: A decorative overlay <div class='MuiBox-root mui-q4ld7j' aria-hidden='true'> has computed pointer-events:auto and covers the form card. document.elementFromPoint at the center of [data-testid=sd-ls-invite-by-link] returns THAT overlay div instead of the button, so a normal user click on 'Share a link' hits the overlay and the toggle never fires. Playwright .click() (even with force=True) failed the same way; only calling element.click() via JS bypassed it. Same overlay sits over sd-ls-submit y-range; submit currently works probably because MUI Button has its own click surface higher in the paint order at that exact spot. Fix: set pointer-events:none on that decorative box (it is aria-hidden anyway).

issues: Horizontal tab bar truncates the 'Documents' label to 'Docu…' — either shrink the icon/label spacing, allow horizontal scroll, or drop icons on <430px. No page-level horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth==390).

action_items: HIGH: In HeroDealForm (Components/SafeDeal/HeroDealForm.tsx), set pointer-events:none on the decorative gradient/glow overlay (currently rendered as div.MuiBox-root.mui-q4ld7j, aria-hidden='true'). It has computed pointer-events:auto and intercepts real user clicks on the 'Share a link' toggle (sd-ls-invite-by-link). Verification: on the landing page in DevTools, running document.elementFromPoint at the center of the Share-a-link button should return the <button>, not the overlay div.
Minor: On mobile (<=430px) the SafeDeal home tab bar truncates 'Documents' to 'Docu…'. Consider icon-only labels below ~430px, or make the tab strip horizontally scrollable.
critical_code_review_comments: Decorative overlays that don't need clicks should always be pointer-events:none (aria-hidden alone doesn't stop hit-testing). The current .mui-q4ld7j pattern in HeroDealForm is a latent trap for any button placed under it.
sd-activity-deal-filter appears to be a MUI Select (options only exist in the popover portal); a native <select> would be simpler for testability but that's optional. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional checks pass except the Share-a-link overlay bug)
